title: Turbulent flow in a 90° bend, k-ω SST, against the PTB LDA
headline: at 1.6 M cells, within 0.02–0.07 U_b RMS of the LDA at six planes, peaks on the measured side; the levels not yet asymptotic (wall-function y⁺ drift)

references.source: straka_and_koglin_etal_2020 (LDA, PTB Berlin; the profiles as ekat_and_weissenbrunner_etal_2023 Fig. 3 gives them)

toolchain.conversion: gmshToFoam, with -keepOrientation when the worst scaled Jacobian is positive (task 0108)

gates.quantity: axial velocity $w/W_{vol}$ on the horizontal line through the axis, at the six LDA planes (2.43 to 30.82 D after the bend), finest level
gates.limit: RMS difference over the 19 LDA points of each plane within 0.10

gates.quantity: the side of the peak of $w$ at each plane, finest level
reported, not gated: the bend's loss coefficient K with GCI (k = 1, 2, 3); the peak $w$ at 2.43 D and 10.7 D with GCI; Ekat et al.'s own k-ω SST RMS per plane beside ours

lessons.text: refined(k) splits the wall cell k ways, so with wall functions the first-cell y+ falls as 1/k (23, 11.6, 7.8 here) and f drifts from McKeon (+0.6 %, +6.1 %, +9.0 %): for a study, fix first_cell and refine the rest.
potentialFoam as the initial field gave 2.7e4 m/s in thin wall cells of a fine bend mesh and simpleFoam blew up at step 1; starting from rest worked.
A periodic precursor decomposed on 4 processes floored its cross-flow residuals (Uy, Uz) at 2-5e-7, above residualControl 1e-7, and never stopped; on one process it converged in 3245 steps.
